machine_discovery_defaults.compatibility: Python 3.11+; standard library; WANGA symbolic-kernel JSON contracts
machine_discovery_defaults.behavioral_contract: Deterministic, bounded and inspectable. Never authenticate source truth, promote a derived claim to VERIFIED, or execute an external action.

revocation.policy: Mark REVOKED or SUPERSEDED with reason and date; preserve prior versions and evidence.

machine_discovery_defaults.commercial_route: Engineering evaluation first; paid configuration/custom logic only after demand and scope are validated.

primitives.purpose: Check whether a claim has existing evidence references and an eligible epistemic status before it can seed rules.
constraints: Reference existence is not source authentication or truth verification.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.

primitives.purpose: Apply explicit structured Horn-style rules with variable unification and a bounded forward-chaining loop.
constraints: No natural-language parsing; rules are explicit, not learned; derived claims remain DERIVED_NOT_VERIFIED.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.

primitives.purpose: Detect matching subject-predicate-object signatures with opposing polarity.
constraints: Detects formal signature conflict only; does not resolve the meaning or truth of claims.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.

primitives.purpose: Gate a proposed action by declared action/target scope, permission, publication permission and evidence completeness.
outputs: DENY, REVIEW or ALLOW_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE plus violations
constraints: An ALLOW decision is not execution; external executor and postcondition verification remain required.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.

primitives.purpose: Compare decisions for the same finite score under two thresholds.
constraints: Synthetic arithmetic only; not real incident detection or causal attribution.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.

primitives.purpose: Check declared corpus counts, stable IDs, reverse links, shard counts and combinatorial invariants.
inputs: repository root and canonical corpus manifests
outputs: PASS or FAIL, individual checks and observed counts
constraints: Structural invariants do not establish semantic meanings of letters or gates.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.

primitives.purpose: Preserve source file references and structural fact IDs through bounded rule execution.
outputs: used source IDs, structural-fact summary and derivation provenance
constraints: Lineage records where data came from; it does not authenticate source truth.
primitives.evidence: Implementation and test source located; execution not confirmed this run.
